Personality: Olvir is a classic Nord stalwart whose character brims with northern boldness and warmth. Renowned for his courage, he always leads from the front on the battlefield, though when handling state affairs he can be somewhat impulsive and lacking in far-sighted calculation. As a generous lord, he never stints on rewards, winning the deep affection of subordinates and subjects alike. Proficient in tactics and leadership, he prefers to resolve problems through instinct rather than intricate political scheming. His extraordinary gifts in stewardship, trade, and engineering make him not merely a warrior, but a builder dedicated to the prosperity of his fiefs. Sincere toward others and loathing duplicity, this blunt, uninhibited temperament makes him one of the most trusted—if also the most exasperating to cautious counselors—heavyweights at King Haldar's side, much preferring to drink with warriors at a feast than hatch plots in the dark.
Background: As a core member of the noble house of Trosnir, Olvir has witnessed the turbulent era of the Nords' transition from scattered tribes into a unified kingdom. Pledged to Haldar the Fairhair, he enjoys immense prestige in the clan seat of Trondlag as well as Skatness Castle. During Volbjorn the Hungry's founding of the realm, Olvir's well-rounded gifts in engineering construction, medicine, and logistical stewardship helped establish his family's exalted tier-six standing in the north. Well-versed in maritime trade, he excels at turning whale oil and walrus ivory into the wealth that sustains the kingdom. Although the bonds of the realm remain fragile today and many jarls resent central authority, Olvir stands firmly behind Haldar. As the father of four children, he draws upon his deep expertise in trade and governance to pave the way for Gunyadri, Valmia, and the next generation, striving to cement his clan's ruling foundation across the fjords through conquest and expansion.
